proposal.summary: An excessively large PDF page size can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
proposal.cwe_quote: divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code
proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the handling of large PDF page sizes in Xpdf.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability is caused by a very large page size.
evidence_quotes.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
